summary: Reproduced that the exact candidate only translates the first GPU-only speculative FP4 workspace failure into RuntimeError. Ported the graph-safe native TRTLLM MHA FP4 route for target verify and draft extend, including external draft backend resolution, packed KV scales, and fixed/ragged XQA masks, while retaining the candidate's actionable workspace guard.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate still terminates with RuntimeError instead of completing speculative target verification; raw log: reports/j-92791560cab2/candidate-target-verify-failure.log

18 tests and 16 subtests passed: configuration resolution, hybrid routing, stale workspace guard, TARGET_VERIFY, DRAFT_EXTEND_V2, legacy external draft extend, packed FP4 KV/scales, and fixed/ragged XQA masks. Host-side mocks, not numerical CUDA execution.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned gfx950 ROCm device cannot execute the issue's SM120 CUDA FlashInfer/TRTLLM NVFP4 path; no unrelated AMD smoke is counted.

remaining_limitations: No RTX 5090/SM120 CUDA device or Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 weights were available for a local full-model serving or CUDA graph replay.
The focused regressions verify control flow, arguments, and masks with mocks; they do not independently establish numerical NVFP4 attention output on this host.
No native source was changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
